primary.api_id_caveat: 28 is a widely documented third-party mapping, not re-verified here via videoCategories.list (no API key). Studio shows the label, not the ID — you do not need the ID to set it. [8](https://developers.google.com/youtube/v3/docs/videoCategories/list)
primary.prior_study_suggestion: Education / science experiment (viral_metadata_v10.json, before this pack)

alternate.api_id_caveat: 27 is a widely documented third-party mapping; see the same caveat [8](https://developers.google.com/youtube/v3/docs/videoCategories/list).
alternate.extra_fields_note: Education khud 'science experiment' aur 'real life application' Type deta hai [1](https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/57404?hl=en) [2](https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/57407?hl=en) — dono is clip par fit baithte hain. Academic system / Level / Exam fields bhi dikhte hain, lekin inhe khali chhod sakte hain; ye 49.4 s general-audience Short kisi exam ya grade se bound nahi hai.

where_to_set: YouTube Studio (desktop) -> Content -> click the video -> Details -> SHOW MORE -> Category [1](https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/57404?hl=en) [2](https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/57407?hl=en)
Upload ke time bhi: Studio -> CREATE -> Upload videos -> Edit -> SHOW MORE -> Category [2](https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/57407?hl=en)
Baad me badalna ho to: Studio -> Content -> video -> settings -> Save [1](https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/57404?hl=en)
why_primary: Video ek science / physics explainer hai: curved water sphere refraction se image flip karta hai; NASA Artemis II ka official clip + replay analysis. Isliye topical bucket Science & Technology hai.

Ye 49.4 s vertical Short hai — 8 beats, word-by-word captions aur loop-back ke saath commentary — koi structured lesson, how-to ya exam-aligned lecture nahi. Isliye main isse broad science bucket me rakhta hoon.

Pichhli forensic study ne `Education / science experiment` suggest kiya tha aur wo **bhi bilkul sahih hai**: YouTube khud Education ke liye `science experiment` Type deta hai [1](https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/57404?hl=en) [2](https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/57407?hl=en). Ye pack us purane suggestion ko 'galat' qarar nahi deta; sirf do valid options me se aik final pick lock karta hai. Dono se reach / retention ka koi guaranteed farq claim nahi kiya ja sakta.
category.decision_note: Mera final pick Science & Technology hai; Education + Type `science experiment` equally valid alternate hai. Ye aik categorization judgment hai, koi official ranking, discovery ya engagement rule nahi. Aapko Studio me khud confirm karna hai.
category.why_not_education_as_primary: Agar aap channel ko explicitly educational series ke taur par classify karna chahte hain, ya aapke Studio / region me `Science & Technology` na dikhe, to Education chunlein — Type = `science experiment` (ya `real life application`) aur academic fields khali. Ye koi galat jawab nahi hai.
category.region_note: Category list region-specific hoti hai (regionCode) [8](https://developers.google.com/youtube/v3/docs/videoCategories/list). Agar aapke Studio mein 'Science & Technology' na dikhe, to 'Education' chunlein — dono hi galat nahi hain.
category.no_ranking_claim: Official wording sirf ye hai: 'Select a category so viewers can find your video more easily' [1](https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/57404?hl=en) [2](https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/57407?hl=en); tags bhi 'minimal role' play karte hain [1](https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/57404?hl=en) [7](https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/146402?hl=en). Category se Shorts feed reach, retention, views ya comments badhne ka koi guaranteed asar claim nahi kiya ja sakta.
category.operational_advice: Channel ki baqi science/refraction clips par bhi yahi category rakhein taake classification consistent rahe — ye meri operational salah hai, koi official ranking rule nahi.

primary.label: Replay question (recommended)
primary.text:
Which moment made you replay — the face flipping upside down, or the loop back at the end?

Curved water bends light (refraction), so the sphere acts like a tiny liquid lens.

Source: NASA / Artemis II, "Fun with Water Bubbles". NASA is credited; no endorsement implied.

alternatives.label: Science-first / value
alternatives.text:
Curved water acts like a liquid lens: light bends through the sphere and the face behind it flips.

What caught your eye first — the upside-down face around 23s, or the crew's reaction?

Source: NASA / Artemis II ("Fun with Water Bubbles"). NASA credited; no endorsement implied.
alternatives.use_case: Agar aap comment ko chhota 'science note' banana chahte hain, discussion ke saath.
alternatives.why: Pehli line mein video ka asli explanation; sawal doosri line mein; credit aakhir mein.

alternatives.label: Source-first / rights-heavy
alternatives.text:
Source: NASA, "Fun with Water Bubbles" (Artemis II) — https://images.nasa.gov/details/art002m1200950026_SHARED_Returned_0025_Z9_019_Wiseman

Independent commentary and replay analysis; NASA's native crew audio is retained. NASA is credited, no endorsement implied.

What do you think bends the light here?
alternatives.use_case: Jab source attribution sabse upar chahiye (promotional / monetized context mein sabse cautious).
alternatives.why: Official source link pehle; URLs comments mein hyperlink ban jate hain [3](https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/6000964?hl=en). NASA endorsement ka koi claim nahi [9](https://www.nasa.gov/nasa-brand-center/images-and-media/).

alternatives.label: One-line / Shorts mobile
alternatives.text: Refraction: curved water flips the face. Which frame made you replay? Source: NASA / Artemis II — NASA credited, no endorsement implied.
alternatives.use_case: Mobile par jahan comment preview chhota dikhta hai; ek line mein hook + credit.
alternatives.why: Pinned comment preview ki jagah guaranteed nahi hai, isliye pehli line hi sab kuch keh de [3](https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/6000964?hl=en).

why_primary: Pehli line ek specific, asani se jawab dene wala sawal hai jo video ke do sachche moments se juda hai: ~23.42 s par REFRACTION / ulta chehra aur ~44.24 s par loop-back + on-screen credit.

Genuine sawal poochna allowed hai; lekin incentive, coercion, 'sub-for-sub', repetitive engagement bait ya fake engagement mana hai [5](https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/2801973?hl=en). Is comment me koi reward / 'like karo' / 'subscribe karo' nahi hai.
Doosri line comment ko khud me value deti hai (refraction) aur video ki asli explanation se match karti hai — malicious clickbait nahi [5](https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/2801973?hl=en).

Teesri line on-screen credit 'Source: NASA / Artemis II' aur description ke attribution ko mirror karti hai; 'NASA credited; no endorsement implied' likha hai [9](https://www.nasa.gov/nasa-brand-center/images-and-media/).

Comment me koi hashtag nahi: hashtag rules title/description par hain, up to 3 title ke paas, >60 ignore, aur unrelated/descriptive stuffing prohibited [6](https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/6390658?hl=en).
Koi unverified claim nahi: na 'No CGI', na astronaut ke naam, na 'official NASA', na invented date, view count ya audience result.
mechanics: Comments on rakhein: Settings -> Comments and ratings [1](https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/57404?hl=en); comments off/limited hone par pin kaam nahi karega [3](https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/6000964?hl=en).

Channel par 'Advanced features' enable karein — pin karne ke liye zaroori hai, aur poore channel par dikhne me 24 ghante tak lag sakte hain [3](https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/6000964?hl=en).

Apna comment post karein, phir uske three-dot menu -> Pin -> PIN [3](https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/6000964?hl=en); ya Studio -> Community -> Published -> More -> Pin [4](https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/9482367?hl=en).
Shorts ke comments bhi Studio ke 'Content type' filter mein hain, to pin wahan se bhi kiya ja sakta hai [4](https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/9482367?hl=en).

Mobile par viewer ko comment section expand karna padta hai; pinned comment 'view all' kholne par sabse pehle dikhta hai. Comment preview mein dikhna guaranteed nahi hai [3](https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/6000964?hl=en).
Isliye pehli line chhoti aur sabse important rakhi hai — sawal — taake truncated preview me bhi kaam kare.

Ek hi templated comment ko kai videos par repeat na karein; naya comment pin karne par purana apne aap unpin ho jata hai [3](https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/6000964?hl=en) [4](https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/9482367?hl=en).
avoid: Like/comment/subscribe ke badle inaam, giveaway, coercion, 'sub-for-sub' ya forced engagement [5](https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/2801973?hl=en).
'Comment YES', 'tag a friend', 'click the heart' jaisa low-effort repetitive engagement bait [5](https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/2801973?hl=en).
Aisa hook jo video deliver na kare (malicious clickbait), ya comments me traffic lane ke liye repetitive/deceptive messages [5](https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/2801973?hl=en).

'Official NASA', 'NASA approved', NASA endorsement, insignia/logo, ya current astronauts ke naam/likeness ka promotional istemal [9](https://www.nasa.gov/nasa-brand-center/images-and-media/) [10](https://www.nasa.gov/collaborating-with-nasa/strategic-partnerships/).
Hashtag stuffing, unrelated tags, ALL CAPS, emoji-spam ya description wale descriptive tags ko comment me chipkana [6](https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/6390658?hl=en).
'No CGI' / '100% real' jaise unverified authenticity claims — workspace me human_full_motion_review=false hai.
Guaranteed viral / retention / views / RPM ya audience-result ka koi claim.

caveats: Ye drafting recommendations hain; koi upload, publish, category set ya comment pin actually kiya nahi gaya (status draft_not_published).
human_creative_approval=false, human_legal_review=false, commercial_monetization_clearance=false, publicity_or_privacy_permission_obtained=false — sab workspace evidence me waise hi hain.

High-severity unresolved gate: NASA ke exact wording ke mutabiq 'Short-form social media content generally is considered promotional content' aur 'Imagery with ... current astronauts ... may not be used in promotional content'. Is Short me identifiable current astronauts / possible CSA personnel hain; isliye commercial/monetized ya kisi bhi promotional publication se pehle written clearance aur human legal review zaroori hai. Ye pinned comment us gate ko theek nahi karta [10](https://www.nasa.gov/collaborating-with-nasa/strategic-partnerships/).
Official platform/NASA documentation legal opinion nahi hai.
Category ya pinned comment se reach, retention, comments, CTR, RPM ya virality ka koi guaranteed natija claim nahi kiya jata.
